basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work as a software developer for a small startup, and by night, I dive into the world of streaming, gadgets, and DIY projects. I love exploring new technologies and often find myself tinkering with my home theater setup. When I'm not coding or watching the latest series, I enjoy hiking with my partner and our two dogs. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My interest in home entertainment systems and streaming services has grown through personal experimentation and online communities. I enjoy learning from others and sharing my insights whenever I can.
